article.title: Apple's September quarter in the year-end recap
article.text: Apple recorded $102.466 billion in net sales in the fourth quarter of FY2026, the three months ended September 26, 2026. That figure covers only the September quarter.

expected.truth: The draft carries over FY2025 Q4. FY2026 Q4 is $478.834B full-year net sales minus $364.357B in the first nine months.

article.title: Wipro's FY2025 profit attributable to shareholders
article.text: Wipro Limited's profit attributable to its shareholders for FY2025, the year ended March 31, 2025, was ₹131,354 crore. Diluted earnings per share for the same fiscal year were ₹12.52.

expected.truth: The 20-F prints ₹131,354 million attributable to owners. That is ₹13,135.4 crore.
Diluted EPS is ₹12.52 for the year.

article.title: Walmart's first-half sales tracker
article.text: Walmart Inc. booked total revenues of $187.937 billion in the first half of FY2027, the six months ended July 31, 2026. The total was for the six-month period.

expected.truth: The draft copied the three-month figure. The same 10-Q reports $365.688B total revenues for the six months.

article.title: Infosys annual EPS and the next sales outlook
article.text: Infosys Limited's diluted earnings per share for FY2025 were US$0.76. Analysts forecast that Infosys will report US$25 billion in revenue for FY2027.

expected.truth: The annual 20-F reports diluted EPS of US$0.76.
This is an analyst forecast, outside the historical statement check.

article.title: Walmart Q2 earnings on two bases
article.text: Walmart's adjusted, non-GAAP diluted earnings per share in the second quarter of FY2027 were $0.68. Walmart's reported GAAP diluted earnings per share for Q2 FY2027 were $0.80.

expected.truth: The adjusted EPS claim is on a non-GAAP basis. The GAAP EPS in the filing cannot justify a correction to it.
The consolidated 10-Q reports US GAAP diluted EPS of $0.80.

article.title: Two figures for Apple's annual brief
article.text: Apple Inc. reported gross profit of $228.2 billion in FY2026, the fiscal year ended September 26, 2026. For FY2026, Apple Inc. reported diluted earnings per share of $8.68.
